description: Published biogas plant investment costs used to calibrate CAPEX per country (scripts/calibrate-capex.ts). Local-currency values converted at the Eurostat/ECB 2025 annual average rates in statistics.json. 'quality': project/company/academic = documented by the owner, operator or a peer-reviewed study; press = press or expert estimate; aggregate = sector total divided by capacity. Undated press items are given the year of the article's earliest indication and are weighted accordingly.
